skills.name: Get Date & Time
skills.description: Returns the current date, time, day of week, and timezone

skills.name: Calculator
skills.description: Evaluates mathematical expressions safely

skills.name: System Status
skills.description: Returns current system memory, uptime, and process info

skills.name: Weather
skills.description: Fetches current weather and 3-day forecast. If no location is given, uses the user's detected location. Supports explicit cities like 'London', 'New York', 'Hyderabad'.

location.description: City or location name (optional). If omitted, auto-detects from IP.

skills.name: News Headlines
skills.description: Fetches the latest news headlines from BBC News. Supports topics: world, technology, business, science, health, sports, entertainment, politics, uk, us, asia, europe, africa. NOTE: This only provides titles and short snippets. After reading the headlines to the user, you MUST ask the user if they want you to read the full article (using read_url) or open it in their browser (using open_url).

count.description: Number of headlines to return (1–10). Default: 5.

skills.name: Wikipedia Summary
skills.description: Searches Wikipedia and returns a plain-text summary, extract, and URL for a topic. Use this when the user asks 'what is X', 'tell me about X', or wants factual background on a person, place, concept, or event.

query.description: The topic or subject to look up on Wikipedia

skills.name: Cryptocurrency Price
skills.description: Returns the current price (USD), 24-hour percentage change, and market cap for a cryptocurrency. Uses CoinGecko (free, no API key). Supported: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin, and many others.

coin.description: Coin name or symbol (e.g. bitcoin, btc, ethereum, eth, solana, sol, dogecoin, doge)

skills.name: Unit Converter
skills.description: Converts values between units locally (no external API). Supports temperature (Celsius/Fahrenheit/Kelvin), length (mm/cm/m/km/inch/foot/yard/mile), weight (mg/g/kg/lb/oz/tonne), volume (ml/l/gallon/pint/cup/tbsp/tsp/fl oz), and speed (km/h/mph/m/s/knot).

from.description: Source unit (e.g. celsius, kg, miles, mph, liters)

to.description: Target unit (e.g. fahrenheit, lb, km, m/s, gallons)

skills.name: IP Lookup
skills.description: Returns geolocation and ISP information for an IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). If no IP is given, returns info for the user's own public IP.

ip.description: IP address to look up. If omitted, returns the user's own public IP info.

skills.name: Dictionary / Define Word
skills.description: Returns the definition, phonetic pronunciation, part of speech, example sentences, synonyms, and antonyms for an English word using the Free Dictionary API.

skills.name: Translate Text
skills.description: Translates text between languages using the MyMemory API (free, up to 5000 characters/day). Supports 30+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, and more.

to.description: Target language name or BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'Spanish', 'fr', 'Japanese', 'zh')

skills.name: Process Manager
skills.description: Lists running processes by memory usage. Can terminate processes with confirmation (system-critical processes are protected).

skills.name: Workspace Navigator
skills.description: Lists directories, reads files, and searches the workspace. Accepts a path argument and returns structured results.

path.description: Directory or file path to inspect

query.description: Query to search for (if command is search-workspace)

skills.name: Code Inspector
skills.description: Securely reads and inspects text files within the approved workspace. Blocks access to binaries and external paths.

targetPath.description: Relative path to the file or directory to inspect.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional workspace root directory. Falls back to the JARVIS install directory when omitted or invalid.

skills.name: Propose Patch
skills.description: Creates a unified diff between a file's current contents and proposed new content without writing to disk.

targetPath.description: Relative path to the file to patch.

newContent.description: The proposed new content for the file.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional workspace root directory. Falls back to the JARVIS install directory when omitted or invalid.

skills.name: Apply Patch
skills.description: Applies a unified diff to a file, creating a .bak backup of the previous contents first.

targetPath.description: Relative path to the file to patch.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional workspace root directory. Falls back to the JARVIS install directory when omitted or invalid.

skills.name: Open Application
skills.description: Opens a local application by name (e.g. chrome, spotify, notepad, calculator, vscode, explorer, terminal)

skills.name: Open URL
skills.description: Opens a URL in the default browser

skills.name: Kill Process
skills.description: Terminates a running process by name (with safety checks for critical system processes)

skills.name: Search Web (browser)
skills.description: Opens the default browser and searches the web for a query

skills.name: Autonomous Web Search
skills.description: Perform an invisible background search on the web to retrieve snippets, context, and URLs. Use this skill when you lack information and need to find the latest facts without opening the user's browser. You can chain this with the read_url skill to read the full pages found.

query.description: The search query to look up

skills.name: Read URL
skills.description: Fetches a webpage URL and extracts its main text content for you to read. Use this to read articles, docs, or blogs.

url.description: The full URL to read (e.g. https://...)

skills.name: Security Auditor
skills.description: Scans running processes and checks their Authenticode digital signatures to identify untrusted or unsigned binaries running on the system.

processName.description: Specific process name to check. If omitted, checks top memory-consuming processes.
